title: TaskSpec
description: Structured task specification for a single shenlun question. Derived from paper analysis and task prototype matching.

fixture_id.description: Fixture ID for testing (ts-XXXX). Only present in test fixtures.

source_file.description: Source PDF filename. Only present in test fixtures.

question_id.description: Question number within paper (e.g. q1, q2)

task_id.description: Unique task identifier combining paper_id and question_id

task_instruction.description: Complete task instruction verbatim from the exam paper

material_scope.description: Material section IDs referenced by this question (e.g. material-1, material-2)

full_score.description: Maximum score for this question. Must be > 0.

identity.description: Identity/role the answerer must assume (e.g. 某部门工作人员)

purpose.description: Purpose of the task as stated or implied by the question

output_genre.description: Output document type (e.g. 情况报告, 提案, 短评)

primary_prototype_id.description: ID of the primary task prototype that best matches this question. Must be a real sl-prototype-XXXX, null, or 'general-fallback'. Method card IDs are forbidden.

prototype_resolution_receipt.description: resolve-task-prototype 的真实命中回执。申发论述正式评分必须携带。

task_components.description: Task components identified in the question. Multiple allowed.

required_content_elements.description: Content elements explicitly required by the question instruction

basis.description: Why this is optional: material structure or genre convention

optional_content_elements.description: Optional content elements derived from material structure or genre conventions

required_format_elements.description: Required format elements determined from question instruction. Question instruction takes precedence over genre defaults.

relation_requirements.description: Required relationships between content elements (e.g. 问题与建议对应)

style_requirements.description: Style or tone requirements stated in the question

min_length.description: Minimum answer length. Null if only upper bound given.

subtasks.description: Subtasks for multi-part questions (e.g. 2021 subprovincial Q3)

shared_length_limit.description: Shared word limit across all subtasks

uncertainty.description: Uncertain elements that need human verification
